properties.name: rmcp 3.4.0 → 3.5.0 (declared "3.5"), base64 0.22 → 0.23, and the lock refreshed (23 crates); initialize keeps answering with the newest revision that has a handshake
properties.rationale: Approved-queue item (a) of the 2026-10-01 dependency audit (fact:dependency-audit-2026-10-01-the-full-sweep), its own PR. The pin test failed on purpose (req:reflow2-conforms-to-the-mcp-specification-revision-it-serves: a new revision is adopted deliberately, never inherited by a bump) and was followed deliberately. The threshold test's premise was checked in rmcp's source and did not hold: fact:rmcp-latest-is-not-what-a-nameless-client-gets-and-the-seat-threshold-test-watched-a-proxy-2026-10-02. Verified: cargo test --workspace (2,865 passed), clippy -D warnings, smoke_mcp, stateless_seat_probe.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: rmcp 3.5.0 moved ProtocolVersion::LATEST to 2026-07-28 (the revision with no initialize handshake) and added LATEST_WITH_INITIALIZE. describe_protocol_version, read only as the answer to initialize, now returns LATEST_WITH_INITIALIZE (2025-11-25), so nothing on the wire changes; 2026-07-28 stays served through server/discover's supported list. The pin test now pins LATEST, LATEST_WITH_INITIALIZE and the advertised version. rmcps_latest_does_not_yet_cross_the_threshold is replaced by a_session_opened_by_initialize_is_not_per_request plus a wire test with a sessionless negative control. base64 0.23 is what rmcp 3.5 already pulls; bearer.rs now uses it. cargo update moved 23 crates within their declared ranges.
